description: Deep humanized profiles of Seymour, Indiana businesses. Each profile is independently researched against public sources. Honest, specific, and not a press release.

profiles.name: Rose Acre Farms
profiles.summary: Seymour-headquartered, second-largest U.S. egg producer. Loved as employer, controversial nationally over 2018 recall and antitrust verdict.

profiles.name: Schneck Medical Center
profiles.summary: Magnet-designated independent community hospital. Largest employer in Seymour, exceptional for its size.

profiles.name: Aisin USA Manufacturing
profiles.summary: Toyota-affiliated tier-1 automotive supplier. Stable mid-tier manufacturing job; tough schedule, real benefits.

profiles.name: Cummins Seymour Engine Plant
profiles.summary: Cummins' high-horsepower engine plant. Highest-paying manufacturing job in town, hard to get hired.

profiles.name: Walmart Distribution Center #6088
profiles.summary: Grocery DC supplying Walmart Supercenters across the region. Hard physical work, real career path with tuition.

profiles.name: Valeo North America (Seymour)
profiles.summary: French-owned tier-1 automotive lighting plant. Steady, mid-pack manufacturing employer.

profiles.name: Jackson County Bank (JCB)
profiles.summary: Locally-headquartered community bank. 'Best Place to Work in Indiana' multi-year honoree, 100+ years in town.

profiles.name: Larrison's Diner
profiles.summary: Downtown breakfast-and-lunch spot. The most Seymour breakfast in Seymour.

profiles.name: Rails Craft Brew & Eatery
profiles.summary: Downtown steaks and house-brewed beer in the renovated B&O freight depot. Best big-room dining in town.

profiles.name: The Townhouse Cafe
profiles.summary: Downtown lunch room a block off the courthouse. Daily specials, breaded tenderloin, the actual product.

profiles.name: Silgan Plastics (Seymour)
profiles.summary: Rigid plastic packaging plant under publicly-traded Silgan Holdings. Stable, mid-pay, hot work.

profiles.name: Seymour Tubing, Inc.
profiles.summary: Locally-owned precision welded steel tubing manufacturer. Quietly important since 1956.

profiles.name: Walmart Supercenter (Seymour)
profiles.summary: The Tipton Street Supercenter. Everyday everything store; competently-run example of the format.

profiles.name: SpringHill Camps Indiana
profiles.summary: ACA-accredited Christian summer camp serving thousands of kids each year. Strong programming, openly Christian.

profiles.name: Blacksheep Pizza (Brownstown)
profiles.summary: 12 minutes from Seymour, 4.8/5 across 100+ reviews. Worth the drive.

profiles.name: Kocolene Marketing
profiles.summary: Seymour-headquartered family-owned multi-state fuel & retail operator (since 1937). Quiet local economic anchor.

profiles.name: PepsiCo Seymour Distribution
profiles.summary: Beverage distribution operation for southern Indiana. Solid mid-tier logistics employer with brand and training.
